response.rationale: Cardiogenic shock is supported by depressed biventricular function, tricuspid regurgitation, and need for epinephrine; ARDS lacks respiratory symptoms and typical oxygenation criteria, while TTP lacks thrombocytopenia and hemolysis.

rejected.why: No respiratory symptoms; oxygenation index not clearly ARDS-defining
Low ADAMTS13 and elevated vWF are nonspecific; no thrombocytopenia or microangiopathic hemolysis
